_doc: Dash-only rows, appended after kSignals by gen_signals.py. 0x273 UI_displayBrightnessLevel (docs/signals-and-actions.md, 'Screen brightness'; capture 54.5 %; 0x273 already streams for the dome light) for the backlight. 0x318 SystemTimeUTC for the clock (docs/signals-and-actions.md, 'Date and time (UTC)'). Streamed (3.8 Hz). The vector is a synthetic frame laid out as the doc says (2026-11-13 10:42:07 UTC), not a capture: the doc gives no raw bytes. 0x264 PCS_chgInputPower (docs/signals-and-actions.md, 'AC charger input power'; capture 1.5 kW): the power drawn from the wall, as the car's charging screen shows it (the BMS's chargeKw, 0x212, is what reaches the pack, after the charger's losses); 0 or absent on DC. 0x33A UI_uSoe (27|7, 'Usable state of energy %'): logged beside soc (UI_soe) to see which the car's screen shows.
